d: Act as Muriya's owner-side lead for assigned projects from concept through handover and defects liability, delivering on time, within budget and to the destination's quality and brand standards, while keeping Sales, Finance, Operations and Operators aligned.

The position is at the Muriya's Projects / Development Directorate and serve integrated tourism complexes (ITCs) where residential, hospitality, F&B, retail, marinas and destination infrastructure are delivered in parallel phases at Jebel Sifah, Hawana Salalah and future destinations.
What makes Muriya different from a contractor or a single-asset developer, and what candidates must be screened for:
High cross-functionality: every project decision touches Sales, Finance, Destination/Community Management, Hotel Operators, Legal, Procurement and Government Relations at once.

Owner-side, not contractor-side: the roles manage consultants and contractors, protect the employer's interests, and translate commercial targets (sales handovers, hotel openings, season readiness) into delivery dates.
Live destinations: construction happens next to residents, guests and operating hotels, so phasing, logistics, HSE and brand experience are part of the job.
Omani regulatory environment: ITC framework under the Ministry of Heritage and Tourism, municipal and Civil Defense approvals, environmental permits (EA), Omanisation and ICV requirements.
Multi-site, coastal and remote: Muscat (Jebel Sifah) and Dhofar (Hawana Salalah, khareef season constraints) with travel between sites.
q: BSc in a construction-related engineering or construction management discipline.
8–10 years minimum experience, with full life-cycle delivery of at least two developments of comparable scale.
Hospitality and/or residential real estate experience; integrated tourism or master-planned communities strongly preferred.
Developer / client-side or PMC experience; solid FIDIC contract administration.
GCC experience, preferably Oman; working knowledge of Omani authority approvals.
Strong financial literacy: budgets, cash flows, cost-to-complete.
Fluent English; Arabic is an advantage.
PMP, PgMP or RICS/MRICS; Chartered Engineer (ICE, IStructE, CIBSE) or OSE membership.
NEBOSH IGC or equivalent HSE certification.
LEED AP / Estidama or sustainability credentials.
Marine, coastal or remote-site project experience.
Thinks like a developer: balances time, cost, quality, sales ability and guest experience in one decision.
Builds alignment across departments and partners without relying on hierarchy.
Escalates early with options and a recommendation, not just problems.
Holds consultants and contractors firmly to contract while keeping relationships workable.
Visible on site, calm under pressure, and develop local talent.
r: Lead assigned projects (villas, apartments, hotels, F&B and retail, marina and public realm, infrastructure) across all stages: feasibility input, design, tender, construction, T&C, handover and DLP.
Set the project execution plan, governance, reporting rhythm and decision log.
Manage design consultants, PMC/supervision consultants and contractors to contract, chair progress and design meetings.
Steer design development to the approved brief, budget and product mix; run value engineering without eroding saleability or guest experience.
Integrate operator brand standards (hotel technical services requirements) and Destination Management's operational needs into design.
Control design changes through a formal change-management process with cost and time impact.
Own the project budget, cost-to-complete and cash-flow forecast with Finance and the cost consultant.
Lead procurement strategy and tender evaluation with Procurement, including ICV and local-content requirements.
Administer contracts (FIDIC and bespoke): variations, claims, EOT, payment certification, notices and disputes avoidance.
Sales & Customer Care: protect handover dates, unit specifications and snagging quality; support buyer communications on progress.
Finance & Investment: report against business-plan IRR assumptions; flag budget and timing deviations early.
Hotel Operators & Destination Management: align pre-opening, technical handover, O&M manuals, training and asset readiness.
Government Relations & Legal: secure permits and approvals (Municipality, Civil Defence, Environment Authority, utilities, Ministry of Heritage and Tourism) and manage ITC obligations.
Marketing & Brand: manage hoardings, site appearance and works phasing so live destinations keep their guest and resident experience.
Enforce HSE plans across contractors; zero-harm culture on sites next to residents and guests.
Implement QA/QC, inspection and test plans, and a structured snagging and handover process.
Apply sustainability and coastal/environmental requirements (marine works, waste, energy, water).
Lead and develop the project team, including mentoring Omani engineers in line with Omanisation goals.
Present project status, risks and decisions to Executive Management and, when required, the Board and shareholders.
Schedule: Key milestones (handover, opening) met or recovered within approved tolerance
Cost: Final cost within approved budget + approved contingency; no unapproved variations
Quality: Defects per unit at handover below agreed threshold; snag closure within 30 days
HSE: Zero fatalities; LTIFR at or below target
Stakeholder: Sales, Finance and Operators sign off handover readiness without escalations
Customer: Buyer handover satisfaction score at or above target
Reporting: Monthly project report and dashboard issued on time and accurate

d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic sales professionals who take pride in delivering exceptional customer service and providing creative solutions to our guests.

The successful candidate will possess a strong customer-focused approach, a proactive attitude, and a passion for achieving results. You should demonstrate flexibility, professionalism, and integrity in all interactions with both clients and colleagues.
A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets is essential, along with the ability to identify opportunities, develop account plans, and successfully implement sales strategies.
This role requires a highly motivated sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to delivering exceptional service while driving business growth
r: Ensure comprehensive coverage of your assigned portfolio by maintaining strong relationships with key decision-makers and department heads to achieve sales targets and maximize productivity.
Implement and execute sales strategies and action plans to meet and exceed established business goals.
Develop proposals, negotiate rates, and secure transient and group business opportunities for the property.
Generate and promote sales leads across the Rotana network within your assigned market.
Monitor market trends and competitor activities, providing regular feedback on changing market conditions through sales calls, telephone prospecting, and direct marketing initiatives.
Establish and maintain accurate account files while supporting the effective management of the accounts database.
Adhere to approved sales strategies during negotiations and maximize upselling opportunities whenever possible.
This role is ideal for a results-driven sales professional with excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills, and a passion for delivering outstanding guest experiences

d: ISS International SpA is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Static Engineer to join our client in the Fertilizer Industry based in Qatar

The Senior Static Equipment Engineer leads static equipment engineering for capital projects across the Ammonia and Urea Complex, including pressure vessels, heat exchangers, reformer furnace and tubes, and high-pressure urea/carbamate equipment, from concept and feasibility through FEED, detailed design, and procurement of new equipment. The role-holder is required to promote, follow, and ensure fulfillment of the relevant requirements of the Company's Occupational Health & Safety, Environment, Quality, Process Safety, and Information Security standards throughout all project phases to guarantee the technical integrity, long-term asset reliability, and safe execution of Client capital developments.
Lead static equipment sizing and selection studies during concept and feasibility phases.
Develop static equipment design philosophy for new units and modification projects, ensuring all designs comply with international codes, process requirements, and Client engineering standards.
Promote innovative solutions in static equipment specifications to corporate sustainability goals.

Provide advanced technical expertise and problem-solving support during equipment fabrication, inspection, testing and commissioning to resolve structural or material anomalies and prevent future operational defects.
Develop static equipment lists, design basis, and preliminary datasheets during FEED.
Review licensor and contractor static equipment design packages for technical compliance.
Review detailed static equipment design, calculations, and drawings during EPC execution.
Resolve technical queries related to static equipment design, materials, and fabrication.
Review vendor design calculations, material certificates, and inspection/test plans during fabrication.

Participate actively in cross-functional project safety reviews, including HAZOP, SIL, and Process Safety Management (PSM) assessments, to identify, mitigate, and eliminate potential design hazards related to static equipment.
Prepare and review static equipment technical specifications, datasheets and requisition package for pressure vessels, tanks, heat exchangers, columns, reactors, filters, and any pressure equipment.

Manage the technical evaluation of vendor bids and clarify complex engineering queries during the procurement phase to ensure only technically qualified suppliers are selected verifying compliance with ASME/API codes and Company specifications.
Own and maintain Company static equipment design standards and specifications.
Capture design and fabrication lessons learned into updated static equipment specifications.
Manage time, cost, and quality across multiple ongoing projects simultaneously
Manage the technical interface with other Engineering disciplines, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contractors third-party engineering consultants during all project lifecycle phases.
Provide technical mentoring and guidance to the Static Equipment Engineer on project scopes.
q: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent. 8-12 years of static equipment engineering, preferably in ammonia and urea projects, including new equipment specification, technical bid evaluation, and vendor design review. API 510/570/653 certification is preferred. Strong knowledge of ASME Section VIII and project procurement processes and familiarity with engineering software (e.g., AutoCAD, PV Elite, CAESAR II) Excellent communication and presentation skills with absolute fluency in English.

Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.

Diagnose malfunctions using appropriate diagnostic tools and implement effective solutions in a timely manner.
Ensure compliance with local safety regulations and company policies during all service operations.
Document service reports and communicate findings and recommendations clearly to supervisors and clients.
Collaborate with the service team and other departments to enhance service delivery and customer satisfaction.
Maintain inventory of tools and spare parts, ensuring readiness for all service calls.
Participate in ongoing training and development to keep current with technological advances in elevator systems and safety procedures.
x: Joining TK Elevator Almoayyed W.L.L means becoming part of a forward-thinking and supportive company known for its commitment to innovation, safety, and employee development. We provide opportunities for professional growth, access to advanced technology training, and a collaborative work environment where your expertise contributes to meaningful projects impacting urban mobility and safety.

If you are passionate about delivering exceptional service, advancing your technical skills, and contributing to a safer community through reliable elevator systems, we encourage you to apply for this rewarding position.
